test_title: PYST 37: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following institutions launched a ₹5,000 crore green bond as part of its ₹30,000 crore Government Securities (G-Sec) auction in June 2025?

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, in its capacity as the debt manager for the **Government of India**, managed a significant **Government Securities (G-Sec)** auction totaling **₹30,000 crore** in **June 2025**.
 
• Within this broader auction, the **RBI** specifically offered **Sovereign Green Bonds (SGrBs)** worth **₹5,000 crore** to mobilize resources for green infrastructure. ***Hence, the statement regarding the institution is correct.***
 
• The issuance is part of the **Government’s borrowing calendar** for the first half of the **fiscal year 2025-26**, aimed at supporting climate-related projects.
 
• These bonds are typically issued with long-term tenors, such as **10 years** or **30 years**, to match the long-gestation period of environmental projects.
